protocol.invalidation_boundary: All outputs from the pre-correction simulator are invalid for economic claims. They remain only as an append-only audit trail.
corrections: Queue a close-t signal until close t+1 and first earn the t+1-to-t+2 return.
Expose to each signal only observations whose realized-return date is no later than the signal close.
Let portfolio weights drift with asset returns between scheduled rebalances.
Compute turnover at execution against then-drifted holdings.
Evaluate any rebalance band at execution rather than signal time.
Record signal-time weights separately from executed-period weights so offline ensemble plans cannot import one session of future drift.
Rebase entry and terminal costs for every scored partition and annual-origin window.
protocol.cost_accounting_convention: Trading and financing costs reduce the period net return but do not alter within-period relative asset holdings; post-return weights are normalized from gross asset returns. This is a proportional cost debit approximation applied identically to every policy and baseline.
protocol.purpose: Re-evaluate the already disclosed Generation 1 and Generation 2 formulas under the corrected causal engine before considering any later candidate family.
protocol.claim_boundary: All history is seen, revised research data. Passing every retrospective gate can earn SHADOW_ONLY; no historical output proves future profit, submitted-competitor superiority, or historical options P&L.

data.provider: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint adjusted close
data.null_policy: Use only dates common to every symbol in the applicable panel; never forward fill.
data.frozen_vintage_policy: Persist the normalized panel privately and publish its hash plus per-symbol raw-response and normalized-series hashes. Do not splice providers or backfill pre-inception history.
data.bias_boundary: Yahoo adjusted close is revised, not point-in-time. Today-surviving ETF menus create fund-survival and 2026 menu-selection bias.

execution.entry_cost: Start each scored period from 100% BIL and charge absolute target-minus-BIL turnover.
execution.terminal_cost: At each scored period end, charge liquidation of remaining risky ETF exposure into the BIL sleeve.
execution.leverage_boundary: SPY 1.5x and the TQQQ AEGIS legacy proxy are visible diagnostics only and cannot qualify as the primary champion.

trial_accounting.reason: A conservative deflated-statistics denominator avoids pretending that inspected but rejected ideas never existed.

selection.objective: Among primary candidates passing all pre-robustness gates, maximize the smaller annualized log-growth advantage over SPY in development and validation; then break ties by validation BIL-excess Sharpe, drawdown, and identifier.
selection.recent_interval_role: May veto a hard safety failure after selection but cannot rank, rescue, or break ties.
selection.annual_origin_windows: Use standalone cost-rebased 252/504/756-session windows beginning at each available calendar-year origin inside validation.

raw_return: standalone net annualized log growth exceeds SPY in development and validation
validation annualized log-growth advantage is at least 0.50 percentage points
median validation raw excess is positive in 252/504/756-session annual-origin windows
at least 60% of validation windows at every horizon beat SPY
risk: validation volatility does not exceed SPY
validation drawdown is no worse than SPY by over two percentage points
validation BIL-excess Sharpe exceeds frozen Finly and SPY volatility targeting by at least 0.10
validation drawdown is no worse than frozen Finly by over two points and never worse than 15%
robustness_after_preselection: sign survives every native rebalance anchor
Deflated-Sharpe probability is at least 0.95 using at least 92 trials
fixed-candidate familywise circular and moving-block p-value is at most 0.05 for 5/20/60-session blocks
authenticated Alpaca overlap reconciliation passes frozen tolerances for every used symbol

dataset.provider: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint adjusted close
dataset.vintage_difference_interpretation: This is a newly frozen retrieval vintage; differences may reflect an added completed session or provider revision, so cross-vintage metrics are not treated as exact reruns.

qqq_buy_hold.mechanism: 100% QQQ buy and hold; exposes technology/growth tilt

spy_levered_150.mechanism: 150% SPY financed through negative BIL plus a fixed borrowing spread

spy_vol_target_15.mechanism: SPY scaled down to a 15% trailing 20-session volatility target; no leverage

frozen_finly.mechanism: 21/63/252 SPY-minus-BIL trend vote, 10% volatility target, no leverage

multi_asset_trend_ensemble.mechanism: SPY/TLT/GLD positive multi-horizon trend scores, inverse-volatility weights, 10% portfolio target

equity_bond_cross_signal.mechanism: 252-session equity and bond trends cross-condition SPY/TLT inverse-volatility weights

defensive_sleeve_rotation.mechanism: Frozen Finly equity sleeve plus positive 252-session TLT/GLD rotation in residual capital

dual_horizon_volatility_finly.mechanism: Frozen Finly direction with an equal-variance blend of 20- and 63-session volatility

trend_spy_vol15.mechanism: 63/126/252 SPY-minus-BIL trend vote with a 15% target and no leverage

sector_top3_momentum.mechanism: Top three positive-momentum sector ETFs, inverse-volatility weighted, 15% target

cross_asset_top3_momentum.mechanism: Top three positive-momentum cross-asset ETFs, inverse-volatility weighted, 12% target

equity_dual_momentum.mechanism: Best positive 12-month risk-on ETF; otherwise best positive defensive ETF or BIL

sector_breadth_equity_rotation.mechanism: SPY/QQQ relative momentum gated and scaled by nine-sector breadth

fixed_literature_model_ensemble.mechanism: Equal fixed combination of frozen Finly, multi-asset trend, and equity-bond cross-signal weights

equal_weight_expert_ensemble.mechanism: Equal blend of five non-redundant causal experts, re-volatilized to 15%

online_mwu_expert_ensemble.mechanism: Fixed-share multiplicative weighting of five experts using only realized prior-period excess returns

qqq_regime_momentum_long_only.mechanism: QQQ only when price is above its inclusive 200-session simple average and 63-session momentum is positive; otherwise BIL

qqq_spy_regime_rotation.mechanism: Choose QQQ or SPY by 63/126/252 relative strength only when the asset is above its own 200-session average and BIL-excess score is positive

equity_relative_strength_always.mechanism: Always hold the strongest of SPY/QQQ/IWM by mean 63/126/252-session BIL-excess momentum

equity_relative_strength_absolute.mechanism: Hold the strongest of SPY/QQQ/IWM only when both mean multi-horizon and 252-session BIL-excess momentum are positive; otherwise BIL

sector_top1_always.mechanism: Always hold the strongest original-nine sector ETF by mean 63/126/252-session BIL-excess momentum

sector_top1_absolute.mechanism: Hold the strongest original-nine sector ETF only when its mean and 252-session BIL-excess momentum are positive; otherwise BIL

aegis_direction_proxy_spy.mechanism: Clean-room MIT adaptation of AEGIS-Q's deterministic fallback: score SPY five- and 20-session returns plus distances from SMA50/SMA200 as +/-1; hold SPY at score >=2, otherwise BIL

alphapilot_daily_gate_proxy.mechanism: Clean-room proxy of AlphaPilot's public daily rule: SPY only when close>SMA20>SMA50, five-session return exceeds 1%, and 10-session daily volatility is below 5%; otherwise BIL

aegis_legacy_tqqq_regime_proxy.mechanism: Clean-room proxy of the MIT-licensed AEGIS-Q legacy regime baseline: when QQQ is above its 200-session average and 63-session momentum is positive, hold 70% TQQQ if 20-session QQQ volatility is at most 25%, otherwise 100% QQQ; else BIL

aegis_legacy_diagnostic.source_difference: This proxy uses adjusted-close execution, BIL total return, and an extra traded BIL cost leg; the source uses split-adjusted prior-close to next-open timing, zero-return cash, and no ETF cash leg.

next_required_stage: No corrected Generation 1/2 candidate passed every gate; proceed only with a preregistered later family.
